title: Payment activity
description: One change in an online payment's life (opened, processing, succeeded, failed, cancelled). The backend writes one document per change; MongoDB rejects any document that does not match this schema.

_id.description: MongoDB's own id for this document

paymentId.description: The payment's id in the app's SQL database (table payment)

source.description: Who reported it: the farmer starting checkout, the app confirming after the farmer paid, the provider's webhook, or the seller confirming a Scan & Pay payment

provider.description: Who processes the payment; SCAN_AND_PAY went straight to the seller

providerReference.description: The provider's id for the payment: a Stripe PaymentIntent (pi_...), a Razorpay order (order_...), sim_<id>, or the farmer's UPI reference for Scan & Pay

failureReason.description: Why it failed, as the provider said; only on FAILED
